verdict.rationale: The product page publishes concrete pricing and usage limits: Pro at ¥150,000/month with 2,000 credits, 100 credits per run, add-on credits at ¥98 (discounted ¥90/¥85 on higher tiers), and runs of up to about eight hours. It also states that canceling mid-run still consumes credits, so a researcher can estimate costs before committing. missing for 10: clear per-tier pricing for the Team and Enterprise plans, a reconciled discounted add-on rate (¥90 vs ¥85 appear in different places), any free trial or quota details, and independent corroboration.
